def fetch_database_file(path: str, db_name: str, cached: int=0, ecosystem:
    Optional[Ecosystem]=None) ->Dict[str, Any]:
    full_path = os.path.join(path, db_name)
    if not os.path.exists(full_path):
        raise DatabaseFileNotFoundError()
    with open(full_path) as f:
        data = read_vulnerabilities(f)
    return data

def fetch_database(session: requests.Session, full: bool=False, db: Union[
    Optional[str], bool]=False, cached: int=0, telemetry: bool=True,
    ecosystem: Optional[Ecosystem]=None, from_cache: bool=True) ->Dict[str, Any
    ]:
    if db:
        mirrors = [db]
    else:
        mirrors = API_MIRRORS

    db_name = "insecure_full.json" if full else "insecure.json"

    for mirror in mirrors:
        if is_a_remote_mirror(mirror):
            data = fetch_database_url(session, mirror, db_name=db_name, cached=cached,
                                      telemetry=telemetry, ecosystem=ecosystem if ecosystem else Ecosystem.PYTHON,
                                      from_cache=from_cache)
        else:
            data = fetch_database_file(mirror, db_name=db_name, cached=cached, ecosystem=ecosystem)
        if data:
            return data
    raise DatabaseFetchError()

def get_vulnerability_from(vuln_id: str, cve: Optional[CVE], data: Dict[str,
    Any], specifier: str, db: Dict[str, Any], name: str, pkg: Package,
    ignore_vulns: Dict[str, Any], affected: SafetyRequirement) ->Vulnerability:
    is_ignored = False
    ignored_reason = ''
    ignored_expires = None

    if vuln_id in ignore_vulns:
        ignore_info = ignore_vulns[vuln_id]
        is_ignored = True
        ignored_reason = ignore_info.get('reason', '')
        ignored_expires = ignore_info.get('expires', None)

        if ignored_expires:
            ignored_expires = validate_expiration_date(ignored_expires)

        requirements = ignore_info.get('requirements', None)
        if requirements is not None:
            if str(affected.specifier) not in requirements:
                is_ignored = False
                ignored_reason = ''
                ignored_expires = None

    severity = None
    if cve:
        cvssv2 = cve.cvssv2
        cvssv3 = cve.cvssv3
        if cve.name and (cvssv2 or cvssv3):
            severity = Severity(source=cve.name, cvssv2=cvssv2, cvssv3=cvssv3)

    more_info_url = data.get('more_info_url', pkg.more_info_url)

    return Vulnerability(
        vulnerability_id=vuln_id,
        package_name=name,
        pkg=pkg,
        ignored=is_ignored,
        ignored_reason=ignored_reason,
        ignored_expires=ignored_expires,
        vulnerable_spec=SpecifierSet(specifier),
        all_vulnerable_specs=data.get('specs', []),
        analyzed_version=pkg.version,
        analyzed_requirement=affected,
        advisory=data.get('advisory', ''),
        is_transitive=data.get('transitive', False),
        published_date=data.get('published_date', None),
        fixed_versions=[],
        closest_versions_without_known_vulnerabilities=[],
        resources=data.get('references', []),
        CVE=cve,
        severity=severity,
        affected_versions=data.get('affected_versions', []),
        more_info_url=more_info_url,
    )

def is_vulnerable(vulnerable_spec: SpecifierSet, requirement:
    SafetyRequirement, package: Package) ->bool:
    version = None

    if is_pinned_requirement(requirement.specifier):
        version = next(iter(requirement.specifier)).version
    else:
        version = package.version

    if version is None:
        return False

    if is_ignore_unpinned_mode(version):
        return True

    try:
        return vulnerable_spec.contains(version, prereleases=True)
    except Exception:
        return False

@sync_safety_context
def check(*, session: requests.Session, packages: List[Package]=[],
    db_mirror: Union[Optional[str], bool]=False, cached: int=0,
    ignore_vulns: Optional[Dict[str, Any]]=None, ignore_severity_rules:
    Optional[Dict[str, Any]]=None, proxy: Optional[Dict[str, Any]]=None,
    include_ignored: bool=False, is_env_scan: bool=True, telemetry: bool=
    True, params: Optional[Dict[str, Any]]=None, project: Optional[str]=None
    ) ->tuple:
    SafetyContext().command = 'check'

    if ignore_vulns is None:
        ignore_vulns = {}

    db = fetch_database(session=session, full=True, db=db_mirror, cached=cached, telemetry=telemetry)
    db_full = db

    vulnerable = []

    for pkg in packages:
        pkg_name = canonicalize_name(pkg.name)

        for req in pkg.requirements:
            for spec in db.get('vulnerable_packages', {}).get(pkg_name, []):
                vuln_id = ''
                for id_entry in spec.get('ids', []):
                    if id_entry.get('type', '') == 'pyup':
                        vuln_id = str(id_entry.get('id', ''))
                        break

                if not vuln_id:
                    continue

                specifier = spec.get('specs', [])

                for s in specifier:
                    vulnerable_spec = SpecifierSet(s)

                    if not is_vulnerable(vulnerable_spec, req, pkg):
                        continue

                    cve = get_cve_from(spec, db_full)

                    ignore_vuln_if_needed(
                        pkg=pkg,
                        vuln_id=vuln_id,
                        cve=cve,
                        ignore_vulns=ignore_vulns,
                        ignore_severity_rules=ignore_severity_rules,
                        req=req
                    )

                    vuln = get_vulnerability_from(
                        vuln_id=vuln_id,
                        cve=cve,
                        data=spec,
                        specifier=s,
                        db=db_full,
                        name=pkg_name,
                        pkg=pkg,
                        ignore_vulns=ignore_vulns,
                        affected=req
                    )

                    if not vuln.ignored or include_ignored:
                        vulnerable.append(vuln)

    return vulnerable, db_full
